modellers_dream.track_connector.set: Track Connector: position set. Right-click a block to place.
modellers_dream.track_connector.occupied: That rail block is already occupied.
modellers_dream.dispatcher_table.linked: Dispatcher Table linked to Track Connector
modellers_dream.ponder.track_network_set: Select a Train Track and place the Connector nearby
Now we need to add a Dispatcher Table
Right-Click the Track Connector with the Dispatcher Table to connect to the network, then place it somewhere
Right-Click to open the Dispatcher Table GUI and go dispatch some trains!
To dispatch trains you also need to put an empty train schedule to the driver!
